test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: A, B and C can alone do a work in 6 days, 12 days and 24 days respectively. Working together In how much time they will complete the whole work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do a work in 6 days

B can do a work in 12 days

C can do a work in 24 days

**Concept Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time 

Efficiency = Work done in unit time 

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 24 units [LCM of 6, 12 and 24]

According to the concpt used

Efficiency of A = 24/6 = 4 unit/day

Efficiency of B = 24/12 = 2 unit/day

Efficiency of C = 24/24 = 1 unit/day

Combined efficiency of (A + B + C) = 7 unit/day

**∴ Time taken by them to complete the work = 24/7 days**
